purpose: Authored photographic late-afternoon sky artwork, not observed weather. Only the upper hemisphere is sampled; the renderer retains its own horizon, sun and ground.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: full-color equirectangular 360-degree sky texture for a real-time driving game, a technical sky environment panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio, highest available resolution ideally 3840x1920.
Primary request: An exquisitely photographic late-summer late-afternoon sky, deep natural blue above with scattered small broken altocumulus and modest cumulus clouds, fine vapor detail and warm honey-gold sunlit cloud edges. Match the mood of a premium realistic driving game at golden hour in a New England town. Real photography, no painterly contours or flat cloud blobs.
Projection: exact equirectangular latitude/longitude 360x180 environment map. Horizon precisely at the horizontal center of the image. Top edge is zenith, entire lower hemisphere is a smooth continuation of pale horizon sky with NO scenery. Left and right edges join seamlessly. Blue sky fills at least 65% of the upper hemisphere. Keep cloud shapes modest in angular size, especially near the horizon; richly detailed scattered clouds in the 5–25 degree elevation band that a driver sees. No enormous towering clouds.
Lighting: late-afternoon warm sunlight from azimuth at the horizontal CENTER of the panorama, around 20 degrees above the horizon. That region has a soft warm atmospheric glow and golden cloud rims. No visible sun disc. The opposite direction, at the left/right edges, has clean natural blue sky and softly illuminated neutral clouds. Cloud undersides retain realistic soft gray-blue depth; highlights have delicate golden color, not a yellow wash over the whole image.
Style: natural photographic exposure, sophisticated cinematic color, vivid but believable blue and honey light. Fine cloud volume and wisps, realistic atmosphere. Smooth quiet horizon without a sharp line.
Constraints: This is only a sky texture. No ground, buildings, mountains, trees, water, cars, roads, lens flares, starfield, moon, objects, text, logo, border, watermark, checkerboard. No visible equirectangular grid. Not a fisheye, not a perspective landscape, not a cubemap cross. No dense overcast.
